The late Nollywood actor, Francis Duru, will be buried in Imo State on December 11, 2026, his family has announced. The family disclosed this in a funeral announcement shared on the actor’s official social media page on Monday, outlining activities to honour his life and legacy. According to the announcement, a service of songs will be held in Abuja on Wednesday, November 25, at the Family Worship Centre, Idris Gidado Street, Wuye, at 5pm. Another service of songs will take place on Thursday, December 10, at the late actor’s family compound in Okai, Eziama, Isiala Mbano, Imo State. The funeral and interment are scheduled for Friday, December 11, in Okai, Eziama, Isiala Mbano. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Add us to your Preferred Sources The family described Duru as “a cherished husband, father, brother, uncle and friend”, adding that his memory would remain in the hearts of those who knew and loved him. “Though our beloved Chief Francis Duru has taken his final bow, his memories will live on in the hearts of all who knew and loved him,” the statement read. The family also thanked those who had supported them since his death, saying their kindness, prayers, calls and messages had been a source of strength. “Sleep well, Chief Francis Duru. You may have gone ahead of us, but you will forever remain in our hearts,” the announcement added. The funeral notice was signed on behalf of the family by his son, Ebuka Duru, and sister, Anthonia Chenyi, née Duru. PUNCH Online had reported that the veteran actor died at the age of 57 following a brief illness. His family announced his death on his official Instagram page on October 23.
